title: Correct L3 Ready admission incorrectly requiring Draft-only fast-loop

why5.question: Why is PR #403 Final Ready blocked despite full gates?
why5.answer: Exact HEAD required ci/governance/attack/CodeQL have success; Final Ready additionally demands a Draft-only fast-loop while PR is Ready.

why5.question: Why does Ready lack fast-loop?
why5.answer: The CI workflow intentionally restricts fast-loop to draft pull requests and full CI to non-draft pull requests.

why5.question: Why not just switch Ready to Draft?
why5.answer: A conversion is not a configured fast-loop trigger; verified switching #403 to Draft and back did not create the missing same-HEAD fast-loop.

why5.question: Why is excluding fast-loop from L3 Ready not an unsafe bypass?
why5.answer: Ready still requires four authenticated current HEAD pull_request full-gate runs and ordered Local Tests, independent GPT BCE and Human Final Ready evidence. Draft fast-loop remains a separate stage.

why5.question: Why separate PR #405?
why5.answer: PR #403 carries a Human-approved exact two-file governance exception; adding admission guard changes would invalidate its protected scope.

alternatives: Require Draft fast-loop on Ready (deadlocks unless artificial commit timing)
Relax actual four PR full gates (unsafe, rejected)
Change Ready workflow to run additional fast-loop (redundant and risks check name collision)
no_change: Without fix, properly tested L3 Ready PRs cannot satisfy unrelated Draft-only check.
rollback: Revert PR #405 after explicitly redesigning equivalent L3 protected Ready admission; reverting without replacement restores blocker.
negative_tests: Four required PR full gates missing/failing/stale => Final Ready must FAIL
Local/GPT BCE/Human Final Ready missing => FAIL
Draft fast-loop must not be counted as full CI
